#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Deliberately broken standalone script. Used ONLY by
# `lint-actions.sh --self-test`, which copies it somewhere with no extension and
# asserts that the shell-file path fires both of the rules that apply there.

if [ $names == x ]; then       # rule (1): SC2086 / SC2244-class findings
  echo hi
